record.field: Weekly Overdue Invoice Report: Generate & Send (Monday)

field.name: nextcall
field.eval: (lambda base: base if base > datetime.now() else base + timedelta(days=7))((datetime.now() + timedelta(days=(0 - datetime.now().weekday()) % 7)).replace(hour=3, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
